sources.name: PSPKG
sources.notes: Open the source website for its own listings. Do not scrape protected pages, bypass access controls, or expose third-party commercial package links.

sources.name: Brewology PS4 Homebrew
sources.notes: Entries link to the publisher listing, not mirrored package files. Verify each upstream license, required game data, and release status before enabling any in-app download.

items.title: MundoCraft
items.description: Unofficial Luanti client for joining compatible Luanti servers. The game world and content are supplied by the server.

items.title: Descent I + II
items.description: DXX-Rebirth port with a shared launcher for Descent and Descent II.
items.required_data_note: Supply your own legally obtained game data or the official shareware/demo files; the game data is not included.

items.title: Aliens versus Predator
items.description: Unofficial source port of the 1999 game.
items.required_data_note: Requires data imported from the user's own copy. The upstream source release is non-commercial; do not redistribute the game data.

items.title: Fallout 2 Community Edition
items.description: Community Edition engine port with DualShock 4 controls.
items.required_data_note: The package contains the engine only. The player must provide data from their own copy of Fallout 2.

items.title: ioquake3 PS4
items.description: PS4 engine port with separate packages for Quake III Arena, Team Arena, OpenArena, Quake 3 Classic, and Star Trek Voyager: Elite Force.
items.required_data_note: OpenArena data is free and included separately by its upstream project; other game data must come from the user's own copy.

items.title: DevilutionX
items.description: Diablo engine port with support for the original game and Hellfire expansion.
items.required_data_note: Requires DIABDAT.MPQ from the user's own copy, or the free shareware data for the shareware portion.

items.title: Relic Hunters Zero
items.description: PS4 port of the free shooter built from the source code released by Rogue Snail.
items.required_data_note: The game source is open, but art and audio remain the studio's; the package is linked from the developer's release and is not mirrored by the listing.
